comparison.objective: Reconfigure tongue-and-groove pliers from groove one to groove five and leave them locked, versus set and lock a gripper opening stop.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-1985 opens the handles to disengage a tongue, slides a rivet to a discrete groove, and recloses; the candidate performs continuous screw adjustment with two-tool countertorque.
comparison.success_condition: PR-1985 requires groove-five seating, resistance to a 5 N push, flat rest, and clearance; the candidate requires target angle, seated nuts, low stop drift, and three cycles.
comparison.reason: Both alter and retain a mechanism setting, but discrete groove release-slide-reengage does not test counterholding a screw against locknut torque.
